title: Right to Be Forgotten Request Letter Template - Delete Personal Data
metaDescription: Free template to request data deletion under GDPR's right to be forgotten. Submit effective erasure requests to remove personal information online.
description: Professional letter template to exercise your right to be forgotten under GDPR. Request deletion of personal data from websites, search engines, and online services with this legally-compliant template.

sections.heading: Letter Header and Contact Information
sections.content:
Subject: Formal Request for Data Deletion Under Right to Be Forgotten (GDPR Article 17)

To: [COMPANY_NAME] Data Protection Officer
From: [YOUR_NAME]
Date: [DATE]
Reference: Right to Erasure Request

Dear Data Protection Officer,

I am writing to formally request the deletion of my personal data under Article 17 of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), commonly known as the 'right to be forgotten' or 'right to erasure.'

sections.heading: Personal Identification and Data Subject Details
sections.content:
Personal Information for Verification:

• Full Name: [YOUR_FULL_NAME]
• Email Address: [YOUR_EMAIL]
• Phone Number: [YOUR_PHONE] (if applicable)
• Account Username: [USERNAME] (if applicable)
• Account Creation Date: [ACCOUNT_DATE] (approximate)
• Additional Identifying Information: [ADDITIONAL_INFO]

I can provide additional verification documents if required to confirm my identity as the data subject.

sections.heading: Specific Data Deletion Request
sections.content:
I hereby request the complete deletion of all personal data you hold about me, including but not limited to:

• Profile information and account details
• Communication records and correspondence
• Behavioral data and usage analytics
• Photos, videos, and uploaded content
• Comments, reviews, and user-generated content
• Location data and IP address logs
• Marketing preferences and contact lists
• [SPECIFIC_DATA_TYPES]

I request confirmation that this data has been permanently deleted from all systems, including backups and archives.

placeholders.label: Specific Data Types (if any)
placeholders.defaultValue: [Any specific data you want to highlight]

sections.heading: Legal Grounds for Deletion Request
sections.content:
This request is made under Article 17(1) of the GDPR on the following grounds:

[SELECT_GROUNDS]

☐ (a) The personal data is no longer necessary for the original purposes
☐ (b) I withdraw my consent and there is no other legal basis for processing
☐ (c) I object to processing under Article 21(1) and there are no overriding legitimate grounds
☐ (d) My personal data has been unlawfully processed
☐ (e) Deletion is required for compliance with legal obligations
☐ (f) The data was collected from me as a minor

Additional justification: [ADDITIONAL_JUSTIFICATION]

sections.heading: Third Party Data Sharing and Disclosure
sections.content:
Under Article 17(2) of the GDPR, I also request that you inform any third parties to whom my personal data has been disclosed about this deletion request. This includes:

• Data processors and service providers
• Partner companies and affiliates
• Marketing and advertising networks
• Social media platforms and search engines
• Any other entities that received my personal data

Please provide confirmation that these third parties have been notified and have deleted the relevant data.

sections.heading: Response Timeline and Confirmation Request
sections.content:
According to Article 12(3) of the GDPR, you must respond to this request without undue delay and within one month of receipt. I request written confirmation of the following:

1. Receipt of this deletion request
2. Verification of my identity as the data subject
3. Complete deletion of all requested personal data
4. Notification sent to relevant third parties
5. Steps taken to ensure data cannot be recovered

If you cannot comply with this request, please provide specific legal reasons for refusal as required under GDPR Article 17(3).

sections.heading: Contact Information and Next Steps
sections.content:
Please send your response to:

Email: [YOUR_CONTACT_EMAIL]
Mailing Address: [YOUR_ADDRESS]

If I do not receive a satisfactory response within the required timeframe, I reserve the right to lodge a complaint with the relevant supervisory authority under Article 77 of the GDPR.

I recommend using a privacy-focused browser to verify that my data has been removed from search results and online caches after deletion.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Sincerely,
[YOUR_SIGNATURE]
[YOUR_PRINTED_NAME]
[DATE]
